name: Upgrade 15 React Frontend
description:
Create a ferment (auto mode — proceed without pausing for preference questions) that applies the Combined Lens pedagogy upgrade to the 15_React_Frontend/ folder, following the EXACT methodology used for Ferment 019ec153 (Upgrade 03 Algorithms), 019ec1fc (Upgrade 07 Modern Java), and 019ec421 (Upgrade 08 SQL).

## Background

The Combined Lens rubric lives in `00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_STANDARDS.md` (5 dimensions: Conceptual Depth, Topical Breadth, Production Reality, Historical Evolution, Pedagogical Craft). The curriculum-wide audit at `00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md` scored `15_React_Frontend` at avg 2.0 (P2 priority) with HE=2, TB=2, PR=2, CD=2, PC=2. The folder note reads: "01_React_Fundamentals.md opens with the 5W1H and the jQuery vs React comparison (2006 vs 2013 — historical evolution captured in this signal), has a DSA cross-reference table (Virtual DOM = Tree DFS, useMemo = DP Memoization), and real-world company list. Good conceptual depth (declarative model, virtual DOM diffing). Production Reality is moderate (reconciliation O(n) heuristic, real companies, but no explicit production failure mode named)."

## Target folder

`15_React_Frontend/` — 15 files: 13 numbered chapters (01-13) + 00_INDEX.md + CONTEXT.md + 15_PROBLEM_SETS.md. Subject is React (components, hooks, state, context, rendering, architecture, deep reasoning, complex UI, projects, MIT bootcamp).

Prior ferments established the 3-phase workflow:
1. **Phase 1 — Audit**: Per-file Combined Lens scoring across all 15 files; produce `15_React_Frontend_AUDIT.md` with P2-UPGRADE-NN entries; produce `15_React_Frontend_DIAGRAM_INVENTORY.md` (ASCII diagram quality assessment). Mirror to `.kimchi/ferments/<id>/docs/`.
2. **Phase 2 — Upgrade flagged files**: HE additions (canonical years for React 2013, Facebook 2011-2013 internal, JSX 2011, Hooks 2013/2018/2019, React Fiber 2016/2017, Redux 2015, Next.js 2016, Server Components 2020, Suspense 2018, Concurrent Mode 2022, React 19 2024), PR additions (named failure modes from production React incidents), Diagram enhancements (crystal clear labels + NEW sequence diagrams for rendering/concurrent topics), CD/TB depth-and-breadth (conceptual depth paragraphs + variant trade-off tables where applicable).
3. **Phase 3 — Finalize**: Update `00_CONTEXT/CHANGE_JOURNAL.md`, run `python3 tools/update_context.py update + check`, verify all success criteria.

## Constraints (mirror prior ferments)

- Preserve all existing content per D003 (additions only, no removal)
- Preserve any existing 5W1H blocks per D014 (01_React_Fundamentals.md has 5W1H)
- Skip meta files (00_INDEX.md, CONTEXT.md) for upgrade additions per precedent
- Use P2-UPGRADE-NN naming, AUDIT doc at folder root + ferment docs mirror
- Diagram improvements ASCII/Unicode-only (no images, no SVG)
- Mirror prior upgrade log naming: `15_React_Frontend_HE_UPGRADE_LOG.md`, `_PR_UPGRADE_LOG.md`, `_DIAGRAM_UPGRADE_LOG.md`, `_CD_TB_UPGRADE_LOG.md`

## Success criteria (auto-set, mirror prior ferments)

- All 15 files audited against Combined Lens rubric (P2-UPGRADE entries in AUDIT doc)
- Flagged files upgraded with HE + PR + diagram enhancements + CD/TB additions
- Year-regex count, PR-phrase count, diagram-character count, invariant/trade-off/variant count all exceed baseline
- 5W1H preserved (D014), existing content preserved (D003)
- 4 upgrade logs + diagram inventory + preservation verification in `.kimchi/ferments/<id>/docs/`
- `00_CONTEXT/CHANGE_JOURNAL.md` updated
- `python3 tools/update_context.py update + check` passes exit 0

## User mode

User said "create a ferment with auto mode" — interpret as: proceed with the established Combined Lens methodology, mirror prior ferments, use sensible defaults, do not pause for preference questions.
